SteamGuard_Factors_Title: Ways to open this treasure vault
SteamGuard_Factors_AnyOf: Any one o' these opens th' vault:
SteamGuard_Factors_OnlyOne: This be th' only way to open th' vault:
SteamGuard_Factors_PasswordBody: Scrawl th' Steam Guard secret word fer this vault.
SteamGuard_Factors_BackupKeyPromptBody: Scrawl yer Steam Guard backup key to open th' vault.
SteamGuard_Factors_AuthRejected: That weren't accepted. Have another go, matey.
SteamGuard_Factors_ChangeNeedsKeyfile: Yer keyfile sails together with th' secret word, so changin' th' secret re-keys it too. Pick th' keyfile below to press on.
SteamGuard_Factors_AddPasswordBody: This vault has no secret word that opens it on its own. Choose one to add, cap'n.
SteamGuard_Factors_AddPasswordHint: A secret word be required here. It'll open th' vault by itself, alongside anythin' else ye have enrolled.
SteamGuard_Factors_PasswordAdded: Th' secret word now opens this vault on its own.
SteamGuard_Factors_OptionalPasswordHint: Leave it blank an' this opens th' vault on its own. Set a secret word an' both be needed together. Everythin' else ye have enrolled keeps workin' unchanged.
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeyPasswordLa: Secret word fer this security key (optional)
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeysIntro: Each key opens th' vault on its own. Enrol a spare an' stow it somewhere else, ye savvy?
SteamGuard_Factors_RemoveBody: {factor} will no longer open this here vault.
SteamGuard_Factors_RemoveTakesPassword: This be th' only way in that uses yer secret word. Tossin' it leaves this vault with no secret word at all.
SteamGuard_Factors_BlockLast: This be th' only way to open th' vault.
SteamGuard_Factors_BlockLastInteractive: This be th' only way ye can open th' vault in th' app. Enrol another one first, matey.
SteamGuard_Factors_BlockBackupNeeded: A keyfile or security key can be lost at sea, so th' backup key has to stay aboard while one be enrolled.
SteamGuard_Restore_KeyfileChosen: This backup also needs a keyfile, which ye have now chosen. Scrawl th' Steam Guard secret word again to press on.
SteamGuard_Factors_BackupKeyBody: Scrawl this down an' stow it far from this PC. It opens th' vault on its own, it be shown only once, an' forgin' another one replaces it.
SteamGuard_Factors_BackupKeyIssued: Backup key forged. Any previous one no longer works.
SteamGuard_Unlock_NoSecurityKey: No security key be enrolled fer this vault.
SteamGuard_Unlock_OtherWays: Use a key-file or spare key
SteamGuard_Unlock_KeyfileRejected: That file be no Steam Guard keyfile, ye scallywag.
SteamGuard_BackupKey_CopyFailed: Th' backup key could not be copied.
SteamGuard_BackupKey_SaveFailed: Th' backup key could not be stowed.
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeyTouch: Follow th' Windows prompt, then touch yer security key.
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeyUnavailabl: Security keys be not available on this vessel.
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeyWarnBoth: Th' secret word on its own will stop openin' this vault. From then on it takes th' secret word an' this security key together, an' th' key's secret cannot be copied off it, so losin' th' key leaves only yer backup key.
SteamGuard_Factors_SecurityKeyWarnAlone: This security key will open th' vault on its own, without th' secret word. Any scallywag holdin' th' key can open it, though they still need its PIN.
SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileWarnBoth: Th' secret word on its own will stop openin' this vault. From then on it takes th' secret word an' th' key-file together, an' losin' th' key-file leaves only yer spare key.
SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileWarnOldBackups: Backups made afore now still open with th' secret word alone. Forge a new verified backup afterwards if that matters to ye.
SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileWarnAlone: Th' key-file will open this vault on its own, without th' secret word. Any scallywag who gets a copy o' th' file gets in, so stow it where ye'd stow th' secret word.
SteamGuard_Factors_KeyfileSaved: Key-file stowed. Keep it somewhere other than this PC, an' treat it like a key to th' treasure vault.
SteamGuard_Factors_NeedsBackupKey: Forge a spare key first. A key-file can be lost at sea, an' without a second way in that'd make th' vault permanently unreadable.
SteamGuard_Settings_PathCopied: Steam Guard chest path be copied.
